units.source_text: “是啊，我在这儿怎么攒也攒不到钱，才去那家的。

en.t: Yes, no matter how I tried, I could not save any money here, so I went to that house.

units.source_text: 不过，我也不想长期干这一行，

en.t: But I do not want to stay in this line of work for long,

units.source_text: 打算来年无论如何也要去东京学梳头。

en.t: and next year I am determined to go to Tokyo to learn hairdressing.

units.source_text: 我想多赚一点钱，才借给工人们。”

en.t: I wanted to earn a little more money, so I lent money to the workers.
